summary: The dormant forward Execution pair route (PR1044) reused the fixed four-receiver table. Its S1 receivers (FS.GG.SDD d0bb4059, FsQuint 708587f2) pin FS.GG.Execution.* at exactly [0.3.0] and restore in locked mode, and the receiver join requires lock entries resolved at the candidate version. So no forward version could pass a real hosted receiver run or the publisher-side receiver join. The route's controls passed only against synthetic proofs. The repair (Coordination #1026, PR1050) adds selection.receiverSources: the forward S1 commits plus the seven FsQuint SDK-Core source-lock digests. Repositories, fixture populations and both rollback receivers stay fixed. The original pair still joins only the fixed table. The packed bytes embed RepositoryCommit equal to source A, so the receiver lock content hashes exist only after A is fixed. The forward prepare and consumers runs both require origin/main to equal A. Operational order: candidate at A, then receiver branches that change only the version pin and the locks regenerated against those exact packages, then the consumers run at A. main stays frozen at A throughout. This is a source contract only. No receiver run, publication or adoption is established.
title: Forward Execution pair needs its own S1 receiver commits, created per candidate
